test_set.enriched_base_rate_note: test set is conflict-enriched; random P@100 = 0.3993
test_set.test_task_text_format: title + ' || ' + body (verified); train texts constructed identically from pr_texts

notes.repo_rate_degeneracy: All 5,387 test pairs are in repos with zero train pairs (repo-held-out by construction), so the train repo-conflict-rate feature is the constant train global rate 0.3240 at test time.
notes.trained_lr_features: TF-IDF cosine (IDF fit on train docs only), title Jaccard, log1p overlap-hours, same-agent indicator, 14 agent-pair one-hots (most frequent pair = reference), train-only repo conflict rate; IRLS logistic regression, L2=1e-4, standardized on train.
